findings.problem: task admitted under old contract, awaits fingerprint+metadata+session judgment/edit lock, delegator rereads new task without new approval
findings.fix: trusted captured task; each start/native/continuable/send gate checks three revisions+planning+attempt+abort under same task lock until SDK publication acceptance; DispatchAdmissionError cannot route-fallback
findings.evidence: deterministic deferred fingerprint test: updated contract causes zero host starts; API/native/thread refusals tested

findings.problem: accept holds taskLock then waits workspace lease for experience promotion; verification holds lease then waits taskLock to finalize
findings.fix: model result is processing until evidence finalization; pending acceptance blocked; experience promotion and acceptance Jev outside taskLock
findings.evidence: experience enabled advisory fixture early accept blocked; verifier and subsequent accept complete

findings.problem: old root persisted quarantine resurrects a health entry cleared by newer success
findings.fix: versioned per-resource tombstone snapshot; UUID+monotone failure identity; restore only suppresses proven older entries for same aliases; genuine new failure retained; provider reset floor respected; actual success triggers controlled persistence and next request waits at most10s then recovery-required; historical array accepted

findings.problem: closed route recovery objects retained per child
findings.fix: outer logical request finally releases ephemeral objects; retries share accounting until outer completes; persistent current state/manual override survives; late cancelled model request rejected

findings.problem: unlimited budget scans N history on every reservation
findings.fix: scan only positive enabled limits; Jev no scan or imposed quota; tiny limits signature avoids snapshot cloning on unchanged budget; getReservation is detached O(1)

findings.problem: pagination recomputes full artifact UTF8 bytes for each page
findings.fix: private immutable-artifact WeakMap byte count, authority and digest rechecked every read

limits: full validated JSON checkpoint remains O(S),4MiB cap and bounded contexts/message records require explicit future archival design
new health resource union has4096 identity cap; fail closed on capacity, never silently evict safety watermark
metadata cancellation ends a waiter; SDK HTTP abort cannot be claimed
